

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yin Metal Rooster|kanji=辛酉|romaji=kanoto tori|onyomi=shinyū|p=xīyǒu|w=hsin-yu|mi=ɕin⁵³ i̯ɤʊ̯²¹|y=san1 jau5|j=san1 jau5|ci=sɐn jɐu|mc=sin jɨu|oc-bs=sin jɯʔ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Metal Rooster''' (辛酉, ''kanoto tori''; onyomi ''shinyū'') is the 58th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|af|Sestigdelige siklus|ar|دورة ستينية|arz|دوره ستينيه|as|ষাঠি বছৰীয়া আৱৰ্তন|ast|Ciclu sexaxenariu|bn|ষাটবার্ষিক চক্র|ca|Cicle sexagesimal|cdo|Găng-ciĕ|cs|Kan-č’|de|60-Jahre-Zyklus|eo|Ĉina sesdekjara ciklo|es|Ciclo sexagesimal chino|eu|Hirurogeitaka urteko ziklo|fa|چرخه شصت‌تایی|fr|Cycle sexagésimal chinois|hak|Kôn-chṳ̂|hy|Վաթսունամյա շրջան|id|Ganzhi|it|Ganzhi|ja|干支|ka|სამოცეული ციკლი|ko|간지|mk|Шеесетгодишен циклус|ms|Ganzhi|nn|Sekstiårig syklus|no|Sekstiårig syklus|ru|Система гань-чжи|sh|Seksagenarni ciklus|simple|Sexagenary cycle|su|Daur séksagenari|sv|Himmelska stammar och jordiska grenar|th|แผนภูมิสวรรค์|tr|Altmışlık döngü|uk|Шістдесятирічний цикл|vi|Can Chi|wuu|干支|xmf|გან-ჩჟიშ სისტემა|za|Gancei|zh|干支|zh_classical|干支|zh_min_nan|Kan-chi|zh_yue|干支|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 58th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Metal Monkey|af|Metaalaap (astrologie)|cdo|Gĕng-sĭng|de|Metall-Affe|fr|Singe de métal|hak|Kâng-sṳ̂n|ja|庚申|ko|경신|vi|Canh Thân|za|Gengsaen|zh|庚申|zh_min_nan|Keng-sin|zh_yue|庚申|qid=Q798775}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Water Dog|ja|壬戌}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|af|Hemelstam|ca|Troncs celestes|cdo|Tiĕng-găng|de|Himmelsstämme|es|Troncos celestiales|fa|شاخه‌های آسمانی|fi|Taivaalliset rungot|fr|Tige céleste|gan|天干|hak|Thiên-kôn|id|Batang Langit|it|Tronco celeste|ja|十干|ko|천간|mk|Небесни стебла|ms|Tiangan|nl|Hemelse Stammen|pl|Niebiańskie pnie|ru|Небесные стволы|tr|Göksel Gövdeler|uk|Небесні стовбури|za|Diengan|zh|天干|zh_min_nan|Thian-kan|zh_yue|天干|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''辛'' is Yin Metal, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|af|Aardtak|als|Erdzweige|az|Türk-monqol təqvimi|ca|Branques terrestres|cdo|Dê-ciĕ|de|Erdzweige|fa|شاخه‌های زمینی|fi|Maalliset oksat|fr|Branche terrestre|gan|地支|hak|Thi-chṳ̂|id|Cabang Bumi|it|Ramo terrestre|ja|十二支|ko|지지 (역법)|mk|Земски гранки|ms|Dizhi|pl|Ziemskie gałęzie|ru|Земные ветви|tr|12 hayvanlı takvim|ug|12 مۆچەل تەقۋىمى|uk|Земні гілки|za|Deihcei|zh|地支|zh_min_nan|Tē-chi|zh_yue|地支|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''酉'' (Rooster) is Yin Metal; together they form a Biwa (Mutual Harmony) relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|af|Wu Xing|ar|نظرية العناصر الخمسة|bcl|Wu Xing|ca|Cinc processos (Wuxing)|cdo|Ngū-hèng|cs|Pět prvků|da|De fem faser|de|Fünf-Elemente-Lehre|el|Ου Σιν|eo|Skolo de la kvin elementoj|es|Wu Xing|et|Viie elemendi õpetus|fa|وو شینگ|fi|Viisi elementtiä|fr|Wuxing (cosmologie)|gan|五行|hak|Ńg-hàng|he|חמשת היסודות|hu|Öt elem (kínai)|hy|Ու Սին|id|Wu Xing|it|Wu Xing|ja|五行思想|ko|오행|lt|Using|mk|Пет елементи|ms|Wu Xing|nl|Wu Xing|no|De fem elementene|oc|Cinc elements (Wuxing)|pl|Wu xing|pt|Wu Xing|ro|Wu Xing|ru|У-син|simple|Five elements|sk|Učenie o piatich živloch|sl|Pet elementov (vušing)|sq|Wuxing (filozofia kineze)|sr|Пет космичких усмерења|sv|De fem elementen (wu xing)|tl|Limang elemento|tr|Beş element|uk|У-сін|vi|Ngũ hành|wuu|五行|za|Nguxhengz|zh|五行|zh_classical|陰陽五行|zh_min_nan|Ngó͘-hêng|zh_yue|五行|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Years of Yin Metal Rooster==
{{Anchors|Xinyou Year}}
A {{ill|Common Era|ar|الحقبة العامة|ary|إيرا عامة|as|সাধাৰণ যুগ|ast|Dómina común|av|НилӀер эра|az|Bizim era|be|Наша эра|be_x_old|Наша эра|bh|कॉमन एरा|bn|সাধারণ অব্দ|ca|Era comuna|ce|Вайн эра|cs|Náš letopočet|da|Vor tidsregning|de|N. u. Z.|el|Κοινή Χρονολογία (χρονολόγηση)|eo|Nia erao|es|Era común|eu|Oraingo Aroa|fa|دوران مشترک|fr|Ère commune|ga|Comh-Ré|gl|Era común|hi|आम युग|ht|Epòk nou an|hy|Մեր թվարկություն|ia|Era commun|id|Era Umum|ilo|Kadawyan a Panawen|inh|Вай зама|is|Okkar tímatal|it|Era volgare|ja|西暦|jbo|la cabna cedra|kk|Біздің заман|kn|ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಯುಗ|ko|공통 기원|ks|عام دور|kw|Oos Kemmyn|la|Aera vulgaris|lfn|Eda comun|lmo|Era comuna|lv|Mūsu ēra|min|Masehi|mk|Наша ера|ml|കോമൺ ഇറ|nl|Gangbare jaartelling|nn|Fvt.|no|Vår tidsregning|oc|Èra comuna|pa|ਆਮ ਯੁੱਗ|pl|Naszej ery|pt|Era Comum|ro|Era comună|ru|Наша эра|rue|Нашой еры|sh|Nova era|si|පොදු යුගය|simple|Common Era|sl|Naše štetje let|sr|Нова ера|sv|Vår tideräkning|ta|பொது ஊழி|te|సామాన్య శకం|th|สากลศักราช|tl|Karaniwang Panahon (kalendaryong Gregoryano)|tr|Milat|tt|Безнең эра|uk|Наша ера|ur|عام زمانہ|uz|Bizning era|vi|Công Nguyên|wuu|公元|yi|איצטיקע צייט-רעכענונג|yo|Common Era|zh|公元|zh_classical|公元|zh_min_nan|Se-le̍k|zh_yue|公元|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year that leaves a remainder of 1 when divided by 60 is a year of Yin Metal Rooster (辛酉).

Yin Metal Rooster is considered to have revolutionary significance.

In the ancient Chinese texts known as {{ill|weishu|ja|緯書|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q24890026}} (banned by Emperor {{ill|Emperor Yang of Sui|en|Emperor Yang of Sui|qid=Q7419|lt=Yang of Sui}}), with surviving fragments found in {{ill|Miyoshi Kiyotsura|en|Miyoshi Kiyotsura|qid=Q2399435|lt=Miyoshi Kiyoyuki}}’s “{{ill|kakumei kanmon|ja|革命勘文|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11663819}}” (collected in ''{{ill|Gunsho Ruijū|en|Gunsho Ruijū|qid=Q1554852|lt=Gunsho Ruijū}}'' vol. 26), it is written that following {{ill|Kōshin|af|Metaalaap (astrologie)|cdo|Gĕng-sĭng|de|Metall-Affe|fr|Singe de métal|hak|Kâng-sṳ̂n|ja|庚申|ko|경신|vi|Canh Thân|za|Gengsaen|zh|庚申|zh_min_nan|Keng-sin|zh_yue|庚申|qid=Q798775|lt=Yang Metal Monkey}}, Yin Metal Rooster also embodies the metal element, and Xin represents yin energy, often associated with people becoming cold-hearted. Thus, a Yin Metal Rooster year is considered a year when the {{ill|Mandate of Heaven|en|Mandate of Heaven|qid=Q875377|lt=Mandate of Heaven}} changes, marking revolutionary shifts in {{ill|Dynasty|en|Dynasty|qid=Q164950|lt=dynasties}}, known as the '''{{ill|Yin Metal Rooster|ja|辛酉革命|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 辛酉|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q904743}}'''.

In Japan, era name changes ({{ill|era change|ja|改元|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11498853}}) during Yin Metal Rooster years were meant to prevent political upheaval. This practice started in Yin Metal Rooster of {{ill|901|en|901|qid=Q23580|lt=901}} ({{ill|Shōtai|en|Shōtai|qid=Q1324780|lt=Shōtai}} 4), when scholar-official Miyoshi Kiyoyuki proposed changing the era name to '''{{ill|Engi (era)|en|Engi (era)|qid=Q1374325|lt=Engi}}'''. Frequently, era names were changed consecutively in both {{ill|Kōshin|af|Metaalaap (astrologie)|cdo|Gĕng-sĭng|de|Metall-Affe|fr|Singe de métal|hak|Kâng-sṳ̂n|ja|庚申|ko|경신|vi|Canh Thân|za|Gengsaen|zh|庚申|zh_min_nan|Keng-sin|zh_yue|庚申|qid=Q798775|lt=Yang Metal Monkey}} and Yin Metal Rooster years, a custom that continued until the {{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|qid=Q3125096|lt=Meiji period}}, though such a precedent does not exist in China.

{{Anchors|Xinyou Revolution}}
During the Meiji era, scholar {{ill|Naka Michiyo|ja|那珂通世|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11642793}} referenced ''Kakumei Kanbun'' with {{ill|Zheng Xuan|en|Zheng Xuan|qid=Q197649|lt=Zheng Xuan}}’s annotation: 
* “The way of Heaven is not distant; after every three and five, it returns. Six cycles ({{ill|Yang Wood Rat|en|Wood Rat|qid=Q1190890|lt=Yang Wood Rat}}) form one era, four sixes and two sixes overlap, and three sevens multiply to form 21 cycles, totaling 1,320 years.”
Based on this, it was believed that every '''1,260 years''' (21 cycles × 60 years = 1,260, called ''Ichibu'') there would be a major revolution during a Yin Metal Rooster year. Applying this, Naka theorized that the 9th year of {{ill|Empress Suiko|en|Empress Suiko|qid=Q298057|lt=Empress Suiko}}’s reign ({{ill|601|en|601|qid=Q30597|lt=601}}) marked such a revolutionary year, suggesting that Emperor {{ill|Emperor Jimmu|en|Emperor Jimmu|qid=Q200188|lt=Jimmu}}’s enthronement occurred 1,260 years earlier, in {{ill|660 BC|en|660 BC|qid=Q1059526|lt=660 BC}}.

Alternatively, some interpret the annotation as indicating a '''1,320-year cycle''' (60 × 22 = 1,320). In this case, the pivotal year would shift to the year of the {{ill|Yang Wood Rat|en|Wood Rat|qid=Q1190890|lt=Yang Wood Rat}}, three years after Yin Metal Rooster, considered the '''Jiazi Reform Year''' ({{ill|Yang Wood Rat|ja|甲子革令|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 甲子|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q1190890}}). This places the starting point at {{ill|664|en|664|qid=Q30621|lt=664}} AD, the year after the {{ill|Battle of Baekgang|en|Battle of Baekgang|qid=Q608727|lt=Battle of Baekgang}}, aligning with the legendary founding date of 660 BC.

==Months of Yin Metal Rooster==
A '''Yin Metal Rooster month''' occurs in {{ill|August|en|August|qid=Q122|lt=August}} of years ending in 3 or 8 (corresponding to Heavenly Stems {{ill|Mizunoto (癸)|ja|癸|lt=Mizunoto (癸)}} and {{ill|Tsuchinoe (戊)|ja|戊|lt=Tsuchinoe (戊)}}). Depending on the calendar system, this could refer to the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} month or the solar term period between {{ill|Bailu (solar term)|en|Bailu (solar term)|qid=Q1191003|lt=White Dew}} and the day before {{ill|Hanlu|en|Hanlu|qid=Q1193124|lt=Cold Dew}}.

A '''Yin Metal Rooster day''' is the 7th day in the {{ill|Hassen|ja|八専}} sequence, excluding intercalary days.
